figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Left: Total loss is decomposed into Bayes Risk (decreasing with context length) and Approximation Loss (increasing with context length), so a critical point can emerge in some scenarios. Middle: Validation Loss Gap (Val Loss - min_D (Val Loss) vs. Context Length), measured on subsets of OpenWebText, where we subtract the minimum loss within each dataset-size curve (please refer to Figure 15 for the original figure). For each training dataset size, there exists an optimal context length that minimizes pretraining validation loss, and this optimum increases with dataset size. Right: Error rate of Qwen series models on the CWE task from RulerBench when a certain amount of context is masked. Critical points are visible. More results on other RulerBench subsets are shown in Figure 8.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Our modified Position-Weighted Ruler-QA1 (Hsieh et al., 2024) dataset. Multiple paragraphs are concatenated together with context length close to MaxCtl, and a question queries the ‘golden paragraph’ (i.e. the doc paragraph with answer to that query). In the original Ruler-QA1 dataset each doc has equal probability of being queried (i.e. γ = 0); while in our experiments shown in Figure 4, we measure LLM performance on a set of tasks with different hyper-parameter γ, each with different probability of querying far-away contexts.

caption.text: Figure 4: Measured results on Position-Weighted Ruler-QA1 dataset. Left: QA accuracy vs. number of tokens input to the Language Model, for different tasks with different γ values. We observe that: (1) each curve shows a trend to increase and then decrease with context length; and (2) the critic point corresponds to a smaller optimal context length for tasks with larger γ (i.e. tasks requiring less long context abilities). figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: Left: An example of the ‘two needles in a haystack’ task, similar to those in (Levy et al., 2024). The text part is the input to the Language Model, with key information and question visualized in blue; the figure part shows perplexity of the answer token ⟨8⟩ of LLaMa-3.1-8B (horizontal) vs. number of masked leftmost tokens (vertical). Although seeing both pieces of information are necessary to answer the question, perplexity rises dramatically only when the first piece of information is masked. Right: An example of our synthetic data. Each sub-task corresponds to 2 context bits of fixed position. At each time, exactly one sub-task is activate, and the ground truth output is calculated by taking XOR over the 2 context bits of the activate task. As shown in the example, the answer for Subtask 1,2,3 is 0 ⊕ 0 = 0, 0 ⊕ 1 = 1 and 1 ⊕ 1 = 0 respectively, but since the thrid bit is 1 for control bits, only Subtask 3 is activated and the final answer is 0. However, for a model of context length 7, it cannot see the 9th bit required by subtask 3, making it unable to predict the answer correctly.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: Acc vs. Visible Context Length of Qwen-3 series models (non-thinking chat models) on 4 representative subsets of the RULER dataset: qa_1 (document qa, upper-left), fwe (frequent word extraction, upper-right), cwe (common words extraction, lower-left), and vt (variable tracking, lower-right), for a fixed max context length and a varying visible fraction of the input context. Most models show an optimal context length for qa_1, fwe and cwe subtask, while the vt subtask shows increased performance with respect to context length. Moreover, larger model tends to perform better and have a larger optimal context length, represented by the performance comparison between Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on cwe subtask (lower-left).

部分规则/竖线与 booktabs 极简风格混用，表格层级不如纯无竖线设计稳定。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用 theorem/source、assumptions、derived results 三列固定理论追踪接口；将缩写和附录指针放进 caption 而非额外脚注。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: 视觉叙事从 Figure 1 的 Bayes Risk/Approximation Loss decomposition 与 critical point 开始，经 Figure 2 的 CE–Gaussian-KDE entropy 跨架构关系，Figure 3–4 的 task-position construction/accuracy–entropy response，再由 Figure 5–7 把 two-needle intuition、synthetic architecture 与 eigenvalue/CE validation 串起。附录 Figure 8/A.3-2 扩展 task/model/MaxCtl，Figure 9–16 扩展 estimator、corpus、raw loss、eigen-spectrum 与 threshold，Figure 17–18 收束到 synthetic MLP 的 ID measurement；Table 1/2 分别校准 Bayes model 和理论假设映射。
cross_object_system.caption_system: caption 统一使用 “Figure n:” 或 “Figure A.3-2.”，复合图以 Left/Middle/Right 或 Upper-left/Bottom-right 解释阅读方向。Figure 1/2/4/5/7/8/13–16/18 的 caption 写出主发现，但 Figure 3/6/9/11/15/17 更偏 setup/指针；部分 captions 用 bold lead（Figure 12、Table 2）或 bold panel labels，粗体规则不完全一致。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 使用 context length—model CE—calculated minimum 的单层指标表头；Table 2 使用 theorem/source—Key Properties Assumed—Derived Results 的单层关系表头。两表均用黑白 serif、booktabs 风格和最少高亮，没有共同的 performance/cost/failure header system。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 3 定义 position-weighted query distribution，Figure 4 测量 γ 与 ctl 的行为；Figure 5/6 定义 synthetic bit/task 与 Transformer representation，Figure 7/11/17/18 分别给 spectral validation、dataset-size response 和 ID protocol。Figure 9、14、16 是 estimator/subspace/threshold robustness，Table 1 是 synthetic Bayes calibration；没有单独的 standard ablation table。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Figure 1 middle explicitly points to raw Figure 15，Figure 1 right points to Figure 8；Figure 2 points conceptually to Appendix G，Figure 3/4 extend through Figure 8/A.3-2，Figure 7 depends on Table 1 and is elaborated by Figures 9/14/16。Appendix D Table 2 and proofs formalize main assumptions; Appendix K Figures 16–18 bridge intrinsic entropy and intrinsic dimension.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF body/table uses Computer Modern/Nimbus Roman around 9–11 pt；embedded charts use DejaVu Sans/other sans around 5–9 pt，math labels混用 Computer Modern math。概念图与 chart caption 的字号/字重并不完全一致，appendix raster figures 的小字号是主要可读性瓶颈。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: viridis 顺序色是最稳定的 quantitative encoding，重复用于 context length、dataset size、eigenvalue N 和 threshold；但相同颜色在不同 figure 的语义会切换。蓝/橙/绿/紫概念图承担 role labels，模型/任务没有跨图固定 palette。绝大多数 quantitative series 没有 marker/linetype 冗余，因此 grayscale safety 偏弱。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1/15 的绝对曲线与 subtract-min gap 成对设计：一个保留事实尺度，一个突出 optimum 位置。
Figure 5/6/17 的“任务示例→模型中间表征→可测 feature”接口，把概念任务和 measurement boundary 连成可复现路径。
Figure 7/9/14/16 的 line/scatter/heatmap 复合结构，同时展示 estimator 关系、subspace/threshold sweep 和整体 correlation。
使用 viridis 顺序色表达有序 context/threshold sweep，并在 caption 中明确每个局部 legend 的语义。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1（p.2）：最强的机制—训练—下游 headline 汇总。
Figure 4（p.6）：最直接把 γ、accuracy 峰值与 Intrinsic Entropy 增量放在同一页。
Figure 7（p.9）：synthetic data 上 eigenvalue 结构与 CE–entropy 关系的核心验证。
Figure 14（p.30）和 Figure 16（p.34）：附录中最有信息量的 estimator/subspace/threshold robustness。
Table 1（p.21）：对 trained model≈Bayes Model 的最小逐点 calibration。
failure_patterns: 大量 quantitative curves 仅靠颜色与小 legend，灰度和小尺寸下无法可靠区分 series。
复合图在同一页混用不同 x/y 变换、量纲和 panel 网格，caption 需要承担过多导航。
多数图表没有 seed、误差、样本分母或精确 optimum；caption 常写主发现却不提供不确定性界限。
源码仓库只公开部分 measurement plotting scripts，没有与每个 PDF object 一一对应的 generator/asset manifest；无法把所有视觉参数标成 source_exact。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以 Bayes/Approximation 分解为入口，用多 panel quantitative curves 把 context-length optimum 与 Intrinsic Entropy/Dimension 机制逐层连接，再以 appendix 的 estimator、corpus、threshold 和 theorem maps 扩展稳健性，但整体仍高度依赖 viridis 颜色和小字号 legend。
